# Moon Light Car Care

> Car battery replacement, AC gas refilling, car computer scanning/OBD diagnostics, and general car repair in Abu Dhabi, UAE. Open daily, 8:00 AM - 11:30 PM. Services all car makes and models across Abu Dhabi, including Al Danah, Al Reem Island, Yas Island, Saadiyat Island, Khalifa City, Al Bateen, Al Zahiyah, Al Mushrif, Al Rahah, and Al Falah.

Location: Al Funoud St, Al Danah - Zone 1, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Phone: +971 52 340 8703
Email: info@moonlightautocare.com
Hours: Daily, 8:00 AM - 11:30 PM

## Services

- [Car Battery Replacement](https://moonlightautocare.com/car-battery-abu-dhabi): Same-day car battery replacement and delivery for all makes and models. Stocks Amaron, Bosch, Yuasa, and Varta batteries. Jump start service available.
- [Car AC Gas Refilling](https://moonlightautocare.com/ac-gas-refilling-abu-dhabi): AC regas and refrigerant recharge (R134a, R1234yf) for vehicles not cooling properly.
- [Car Repair](https://moonlightautocare.com/car-repair-abu-dhabi): General car repair including AC compressor repair, engine diagnostics, and brake repair.
- [Car Computer Scanning](https://moonlightautocare.com/car-scanning-abu-dhabi): OBD diagnostics, ECU scanning, and engine fault code reading for check-engine-light issues.
